summary: Iteration 173 — BidVex final polish sprint. Validated backend endpoints for QR pickup, storage promotion tiers, admin-only storage auction CRUD, deposit confirmation, and Pydantic V2 migration. 17 new iter173 tests PASS (2 skipped for env-only reasons: no auction with pickup_code in current dataset). Full regression of iter170+iter172 (16 tests) PASS. Frontend: admin login works; StorageAuctionDetail premium Auto-Bid badge renders correctly as VIP admin with bilingual EN+FR text. Admin secondary-tab click selector was ambiguous (matched top-navbar link by text) so did not fully confirm the 'storage-auctions-admin' secondary tab renders AdminStorageAuctions in UI — however the underlying API endpoints are verified and the code import wiring in AdminDashboard.js is confirmed by file grep.

minor.issue: Returns 400/422 for missing facility_id Query param — both are acceptable; FastAPI default is 422 with validation error envelope. Consider standardizing to 400 with bilingual message body for consistency.
Returns 404 for unknown deposit_id — correct. payment_intent_id mismatch 400 branch not exercisable without creating a real deposit; logic inspected and is correct.

integration_issues.flow: Admin Dashboard → Marketplace → Storage Auctions secondary tab
integration_issues.issue: Text-based selector 'Storage Auctions' is ambiguous because the same text appears in the top navbar as nav-storage-auctions-link. Suggest adding data-testid='admin-tab-storage-auctions-admin' on the secondary-tab trigger in AdminDashboard.js for reliable test targeting.

action_items: (LOW) Add data-testid='admin-tab-storage-auctions-admin' to the secondary-tab trigger button in /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.js so automated tests can disambiguate from the top-navbar 'Storage Auctions' link.

(INFO) Tester could not exercise the PNG return path of /storage-auctions/{id}/pickup-qr because no auction with pickup_code exists in the current dataset. The code path is inspected and looks correct (uses qrcode lib with ERROR_CORRECT_H, returns image/png with X-Pickup-Code header).
(INFO) The /promote/confirm and /deposits/confirm Stripe-confirm branches require real Stripe card interactions — verified auth/shape/404 guardrails only, per request.
critical_code_review_comments: PYDANTIC V2 MIGRATION VERIFIED: /app/backend/models/storage_auction.py uses @field_validator and @model_validator (mode='after') decorators; bare V1 @validator(...) decorators are ABSENT (asserted by test_no_v1_validator_decorator_used). Invalid payment_method 'bitcoin' correctly raises pydantic.ValidationError; deposit_required=True with deposit_amount=0 or None correctly raises ValidationError.

RBAC discipline confirmed: GET /api/admin/storage-auctions returns 200 for admin, 401/403 for buyer. POST /api/storage-auctions/{id}/promote returns 401 unauth and 401/403 for non-facility buyer. POST /api/deposits/confirm returns 401 unauth, 404 for unknown deposit_id.

Pickup-QR endpoint /api/storage-auctions/{id}/pickup-qr: auth ordering is correct — 401 unauth fires before 404, 404 unknown auction fires before 403 authorization check, 403 non-authorized user is the last guard. _generate_pickup_qr_png_bytes uses H-level error correction with box_size=10 — appropriate for printing.

Public stats endpoint /api/storage-auctions/stats/public still returns 4 numeric fields (verified_facilities, active_auctions, total_bids, and at least one more). Shape preserved across Pydantic V2 migration.

StorageAuctionDetail premium Auto-Bid callout: data-testid='storage-autobid-premium-badge' renders with correct bilingual text for VIP admin: '👑 Pro Auto-Bid · Auto-Enchère Pro (VIP) — Your max bid is shielded by our proxy ... Votre offre maximale est protégée par notre proxy ...' — complies with Quebec Bill 96.

AdminDashboard.js correctly imports AdminStorageAuctions (line 55), registers the secondary tab {id:'storage-auctions-admin', label:'Storage Auctions', icon:'📦'} at line 90, and renders <AdminStorageAuctions /> for case 'storage-auctions-admin' at line 327. Code wiring is sound.

AdminStorageAuctions.js exposes data-testid='admin-create-storage-auction-btn' (line 118), data-testid='admin-create-storage-dialog' (line 302), and data-testid='admin-create-storage-submit' (line 413) — covers the admin create flow.

Storage promotion endpoints: GET /storage-promotion-tiers is public and returns {tiers:{...}} with ≥3 tiers (basic/featured/premium). POST /storage-auctions/{id}/promote uses Depends(_require_verified_facility) — a buyer attempting it is correctly refused (401/403).
